dz: 巴格雷万德战役结束了亚美尼亚人对阿巴斯德·哈里发的叛乱. 穆斯林对南高加索的控制得到巩固并开始伊斯兰化,而几个主要的亚美尼亚纳哈拉尔家族丧失了权力,他们的残余逃到拜占庭帝国.
de: The Battle of Bagrevand puts an end to an Armenian rebellion against the Abbasid Caliphate. Muslim control over the South Caucasus is solidified and its Islamization begins, while several major Armenian nakharar families lose power and their remnants flee to the Byzantine Empire.

t: 卡扎尔人利奥四世在父亲君士坦丁五世去世后成为拜占庭皇帝.
te: Leo IV the Khazar becomes Byzantine Emperor following the death of his father Constantine V.
dz: 卡扎尔人利奥四世在父亲君士坦丁五世去世后成为拜占庭皇帝.
de: Leo IV the Khazar becomes Byzantine Emperor following the death of his father Constantine V.
